_comment: Tracking pin for the `unstable` package set: the head of the upstream default branch (`branch`), plus the archive hash of that commit and the hash of its pnpm dependency store. Unlike `versions`, this object is not append-only — .github/workflows/update-versions.yml rewrites it whenever the branch moves, so `dshPackageSets.unstable` always builds the newest commit CI has seen. Refresh it by hand with `./scripts/prefetch-dsh-version.sh --unstable > /tmp/unstable.json && ./scripts/merge-unstable.py pkgs/unstable.json /tmp/unstable.json`.
